# Changelog

Format based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/),
versioning follows [SemVer](https://semver.org/).

## [2.2.0](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/2.1.0...2.2.0) - 2026-11-20

### ⚠️ Behavior changes

- `options.api` (autocomplete) sends no request without a host policy in JSON Forms
  `config.apiPolicy`: list `'self'` and/or exact origins in `allowedOrigins`, or resolve requests
  with `resolve`. Redirects are refused and UI schemas only send CORS-safelisted headers unless
  `allowedHeaders` says otherwise (`b07990b`, `7b29970`).
- `Categorization` keeps the active category in memory and no longer writes `#tab=…` into the page
  URL; `options.urlHash: true` restores the hash sync (`d48221b`).
- `<FormBuilder>` persists no draft by default; `:storage-key="true"` restores the historical
  `localStorage` key, or pass your own key (`a832c2f`).
- A new `date-time` value without custom `pattern` is written with the browser's offset
  (`…T10:30:00+01:00`), as JSON Forms does; `options.dateTimeOffset: 'none'` keeps naive values
  (`39c8fea`).
- `createJsonFormsTranslator({ locale })` now also returns the library's interface texts: an
  English locale shows English buttons, confirmations and pickers. Without a `locale`, or without a
  translator, the texts stay in French (`d3f3340`).

### ✨ Features

- Every interface text (arrays, confirmations, pickers, upload, WYSIWYG, AI assistant, builder)
  goes through the JSON Forms translator under `jsonformsBuilder.*` keys, with French and English
  catalogs (`UI_MESSAGES`); host `messages` override any text, calendars follow
  `jsonformsBuilder.locale`, and `<FormBuilder>` takes `locale` and `translate` props
  (`d3f3340`).
- Entry points `@ficsysfr/jsonforms_builder/core` (renderers without any Tiptap import),
  `/advanced` (WYSIWYG, `allRenderers`), `/builder` and `/icons`, with `"sideEffects": false`; the
  root keeps re-exporting everything. A page on `/core` drops from 591 kB to 387 kB gzipped
  (`99cdf5e`).
- `strictCspRenderers`: the core renderers that run under a CSP without `'unsafe-inline'`,
  `'unsafe-eval'`, `data:` or `blob:` (file upload left out), with a documented recipe
  (`9c7ad17`, `4680af1`).
- Published icon lists `CONTROL_ICONS`, `WYSIWYG_ICONS`, `BUILDER_ICONS` and `LIBRARY_ICONS`, from
  a dependency-free `./icons` entry importable in `nuxt.config` (`e9df6ba`).
- Host policy for `options.api`: `resolve`, `allowedOrigins` (`'self'` for the page origin),
  `credentials` and `allowedHeaders` (`b07990b`, `7b29970`).
- `useUiControl` exposes `isLocked`, `localErrors` and `serverErrors` for custom renderers
  (`a9a3caa`, `7045f69`).

### 🐛 Fixes

- Read-only mode is honoured by every control: checkbox, switch, radio group, select menus,
  autocomplete, multi-enum and the `oneOf` variant selector stayed editable; JSON Forms 3.8's
  separate `readonly` state (READONLY rules, `config.separateReadonlyFromDisabled`) now locks
  controls and reaches nested renderers (`a9a3caa`).
- Errors supplied through `additional-errors` are kept apart from local validation errors and stay
  visible before the first touch; `enableFilterErrorsBeforeTouch` now also hides the message,
  not only the color, and a change counts as a touch (`7045f69`).
- A `oneOf` of constants (`[{ const, title }]`) renders as a searchable select instead of a
  combinator with one sub-form per constant (`248a6b7`).
- RFC 3339 `date-time` values with an offset (`+05:30`, `Z`) were shown empty and lost their
  offset when edited; the wall time is now shown with a `UTC±HH:mm` hint and written back with its
  offset (`39c8fea`).
- `oneOf`/`anyOf` renderers no longer compile every variant with Ajv on each render, which a CSP
  without `'unsafe-eval'` refused (`4680af1`).
- A relative `options.api.url` without `base` resolves against the page instead of throwing
  (`b07990b`).
- The WYSIWYG renderer's imports of `@tiptap/core`, `pm`, `vue-3` and `extension-image` are
  declared as optional `^3.30.5` peers, so strict installers can resolve them (`3baad2c`).
- The `typescript` peer dependency is now optional and accepts `^5 || ^6 || ^7`: TypeScript is only
  needed to type-check the host or to consume `./source`, and the former required `^5` peer made
  TypeScript 6 hosts fail strict peer resolution (`23170e1`).
- Sources pass TypeScript 6's default `strict` mode, which matters to hosts type-checking the
  `./source` export; `strict` is now explicit in the library configuration (`49ebe1a`).
- The npm package ships `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, with the MIT notices of the JSON Forms derived
  code and of Day.js, which `dist/` bundles; the Day.js notice was missing (`87dd86a`).

### 📝 Documentation

- Guides (FR/EN): interface language, strict CSP, offline icons, entry points, read-only sources,
  local and server errors, time zone offsets, `config.apiPolicy`, Categorization `urlHash`,
  builder `storage-key`, `locale` and `translate`.
- Installation guide (FR/EN) and README: optional `typescript` peer and license notices to
  reproduce when redistributing the library.

### 🔧 Internal

- Tiptap floor raised to `^3.30.5`, every `@tiptap` and `prosemirror` package relocked on one
  version (`1123073`).
- `radash` (unpublished since 2025-06-18) replaced by internal helpers with the same contracts
  (`7fca010`).
- CI matrix: Nuxt UI 4.10 and 4.12 × TypeScript 5.9 and 6.0, each cell running type-check, build,
  unit tests and the Chromium recipe (strict CSP, read-only, server errors, `./core` without
  Tiptap) (`a8096e8`, `9c7ad17`).
- The package audit checks entry points, `sideEffects`, that every runtime import of `src` is
  declared, the optional `typescript` peer and a notice section for every bundled third-party
  package (`99cdf5e`, `3baad2c`, `49ebe1a`, `87dd86a`); size budgets raised to 900 kB packed and 4.25 MB unpacked for
  the per-entry chunks and the two catalogs (`4eb690a`).
- The Chromium recipe also renders the form in English (`d3f3340`).

## [2.1.0](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/2.0.2...2.1.0) - 2026-10-19

### ✨ Features

- WYSIWYG renderer: tables, task lists, alignment, colors, highlights, link panel, find & replace,
  source mode, preview, an opt-in text bubble and an opt-in slash palette (`0de8d92`).
- Optional AI writing assistant over a host AI SDK endpoint (UI message stream, text stream or
  JSON); results stay in a detached panel until accepted, requests are abortable and the feature
  is inert unless `ai.enabled` is `true` (`0de8d92`).
- `options.contentType: 'markdown'` stores the WYSIWYG value as a Markdown string through TipTap's
  Markdown extension; source mode edits the raw Markdown and the builder inspector offers the
  Markdown format (`string` schema).

### 🐛 Fixes

- The `@nuxt/ui` peer dependency now requires `^4.10`: the rating control imports `UInputRating`,
  which first shipped in Nuxt UI 4.10.0, so hosts on 4.8 or 4.9 failed to build.

### 📝 Documentation

- WYSIWYG & AI guide, Markdown storage options and playground example (FR/EN).

## [2.0.2](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/2.0.1...2.0.2) - 2026-09-08

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Official v2 packages move to `@ficsysfr/jsonforms_builder` and
  `@ficsysfr/jsonforms_builder-mcp`. Public exports, the MCP binary name and the historical builder
  draft key stay unchanged; only installation and import paths change.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Added blocking TypeScript validation and corrected TipTap `NodeView`, invalid UI-schema input,
  JSON Schema `allOf` accumulation and non-textual date-format handling (`aca301d`).

### 📝 Documentation

- Moved canonical repository, Pages, Codecov and contributor links to FicSysFR (`8922fb4`).
- Updated installation, Tailwind, Vite and MCP examples for the `@ficsysfr` scope.

### 🔧 Internal

- Added audited npm tarballs, checksums, versioned changelog sources and one idempotent release
  workflow using npm Trusted Publishing provenance.
- The one-use bootstrap run freezes the former `@tacxou` v2 packages only after both FicSysFR
  packages have passed registry integrity and dist-tag verification.

## [2.0.1](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/2.0.0...2.0.1) - 2026-08-11

### 🔧 Internal

- Synchronized the library and MCP package versions for publication (`7864b28`).

## [2.0.0](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/1.0.3...2.0.0) - 2026-08-11

Complete stack change: the renderers no longer build on Quasar but on
**Nuxt UI 4 + Tailwind CSS 4**, and therefore inherit the host application's theme automatically.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Renderers rewritten on the Nuxt UI `U*` components: `nuxtUiRenderers` and `allRenderers` replace
  the Quasar entry points (`c3a864d`).
- `@nuxt/ui` becomes a peer dependency alongside Vue and JSON Forms (`c3a864d`).
- Tailwind 4 consumers must include the package's `dist` directory as a source (`c3a864d`).
- v1 remains available from the `v1-quasar` branch and `@tacxou/jsonforms_builder@1.x`.

### ✨ Features

- Added the visual schema/UI-schema builder with draft persistence and JSON export (`b7deded`,
  `586c236`).
- Added PIN, color, file upload, rating, calendar, tags, slider and rich-text controls.
- Added date ranges, configurable icons, `clearOnHide`, `allOf` handling and richer array support.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Preserved partially typed years and object data, blocked self-referencing schema recursion and
  avoided stale menu listeners during subtree unmounts.

### ⚡ Performance

- Reduced object renderer work and optimized deep `allOf` flattening.

### 📝 Documentation

- Added the VitePress documentation, embedded playground and detailed integration guides.

### 🔧 Internal

- Migrated from Bun to Yarn Classic, replaced ESLint/Prettier with Biome and split regression and
  performance test suites.
